target.prompt_format: raw text, tokenizer default special tokens (no chat template)

assumptions.note: Placeholders for planning only. Replace with the preflight measurement before budgeting a rental.

experiments.description: One client, one worker, one sequence at a time: the uncontended latency floor.
Four clients against a serial worker: measures queueing delay, not batched throughput.
Eight clients, which equals the default queue capacity; the upper bound before rejections.
Long context (about 550 prompt tokens) and long output (256 tokens).
Paced arrivals at increasing rates; inspect dispatch lag to see when offered load exceeds service.
Arrivals above service capacity; expect bounded 503 overloaded responses, not unbounded queueing.

experiments.reason: Requires a human to terminate the worker process; procedure is in docs/v09-runpod-runbook.md.
steps: Start the worker under tensorpilot.supervisor with --max-restarts 3.
Run a closed-loop load at concurrency 2 for 60 seconds.
Send SIGKILL to the worker PID while a stream is active; record the terminal event the client sees.
Wait for readiness; confirm the supervisor lifecycle log shows worker_restart_scheduled then worker_ready.
Repeat one closed-loop run and confirm recovery without replayed tokens.
